messages.subject: Project Drake — pro-forma cap table & draft funds flow
messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus, Priya,

Attached are (1) the pro-forma cap table showing pre- and post-money positions (investors 25%, enlarged pool 12% of post-money, founders the balance) and (2) the draft Funds Flow Statement for completion. Please check the bank details and the cost lines — legal fees, the capped investor-fee contribution, Marlow Tax's DD fee and the Companies House filing fee. Net proceeds to the company are shown at the foot.

Grateful for confirmation so we can lock these before signing.

James

James Osei
Senior Associate | Corporate
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ

messages.plaintextBody:
James — cap table looks right and ties to our model. On the funds flow, our outbound account is the Sterling Commercial Bank account you've listed; please use that. One correction: Marlow's DD fee should be £18,000 (ex VAT) — looks like that's what you have. Otherwise approved.

Priya
